# Tailwind Layout Builder Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Tailwind CSS

## Overview

Creates responsive layouts using Tailwind CSS utility classes with flexbox, grid, and container queries for modern web applications

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [tailwind-layout-builder-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
tailwind-layout-builder-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@tailwind-layout-builder` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build responsive layouts with Tailwind breakpoints
- Implement CSS Grid layouts with Tailwind utilities
- Create flexbox-based component layouts
- Use container queries for component-level responsiveness

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Tailwind Layout**: Flexbox and grid utility documentation
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first breakpoint system
- **Container Queries**: Component-level responsive patterns
